rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a woman on her wedding day or newly married.

example.english: Tomorrow I’ll be the bride, and I’m so nervous I can’t sleep.
example.traditional: 聽日就輪到我做新娘喇，緊張到瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 zau6 leon4 dou3 ngo5 zou6 san1 noeng4 laa3 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 fan3 m4 zoek6
